# Clips Lawn Care

> Clips Lawn Care LLC is a residential and commercial lawn care and landscaping company based in Bend, Oregon, serving Bend, Redmond, Sunriver, Prineville, and La Pine.

Clips Lawn Care offers recurring lawn maintenance plans (Basic and Premium) for residential and commercial/HOA properties, add-on packages (weed control, trimming, irrigation), standalone aeration and dethatching, a monthly cleanup maintenance subscription, a separate weekly maintenance sign-up program, and project-based landscape work including mulching, rock installation, garden beds, planting, pressure washing, cleanups, restoration projects, pine needle removal, and sod installation/removal.

## Services

- [Residential Lawn Care](https://clipslawncare.com/services/residential): Basic and Premium weekly/bi-weekly maintenance plans for homes, with add-on packages for weed control, trimming, and irrigation.
- [Commercial & HOA Lawn Care](https://clipslawncare.com/services/commercial): The same Basic and Premium maintenance plans, scaled for businesses, HOAs, and multi-unit properties.
- [Landscape Projects](https://clipslawncare.com/services/landscape): Mulching, rock installation, garden beds, planting, pressure washing, cleanups, restoration projects, pine needle removal, and sod installation/removal.
- [All Services Overview](https://clipslawncare.com/services): Summary of the Residential, Commercial, and Landscape divisions.
- [Weekly Maintenance Sign-Up](https://clipslawncare.com/maintenance-signup): Choose a Basic or Premium weekly maintenance package and submit property details directly.
